notes.title: Episode 6 patch notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Character Journal[/b] - You can find the character journal in the menu. Look for 'Journal'. If you don't see any entries, just start the episode and they should fill up after like one second. Entries will be updated the more you interact with the character. Heart symbols on journal entries indicate main LI's (LI's that will have a unique solo ending should you choose to go with that route). Please remember that you can pursue all the LI's and change your decision to be a one woman man later on if you want to experience all the relationships for now. Your call.

[*] [b]Added achievements[/b] - Achievements for this episode have been added and should automatically sync with your Steam account. Note that there are achievements from older episodes that will come with the next episode. I didn't activate all of them because I thought having so many pop ups would get annoying. The variables are tracked and saved in your game so you will get them when I activate them even though they're older ones.

[*] [b]The dialogue system[/b] - I didn't talk about this one when I implemented it in the previous episode but basically, sometimes, you'll get options to respond in a certain way - Friendly, Funny, Flirty, Aggressive. These responses will be linked to achievements/bonus image unlocks/bonus action and dialogue unlocks. For example : If you're always aggressive, you might be able to perform aggressive actions in some scenes based on how high your aggression points are.

[*] [b]General notes[/b] - As you all know, I moved to another country and it took me a while to find a place, settle down and start working, which is what caused this gap between the previous episode and this one. I apologize for the delay and assure you that releases will be much faster now that I'm all settled in. The next episode is planned in the first few week or two of January and may even be out if I finish before that.

I realize that the slow burn might be getting too slow for some of you. All I can say is that the next episode will change that. I've already written down most of the scenes for the next one so I just have to start working on renders now. If you have any questions or if you find any bugs, feel free to join my discord channel. Click on the logo at the main menu and come say hi.

Thank you all for giving my game a shot!

- CC
[/list]

notes.title: Episode 5 is live.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[b]No spoilers ahead but I recommend reading this after you've played the update.[/b]

First of all, thank you for being patient.
Somehow, after every update, something happens irl that takes me away from my work for a little while. This time it's the move to another country. I leave this month so I couldn't really delay the episode any longer since I still have to pack. Overall, I feel like I got the message that I wanted the episode to convey, across.

Up until now, the story has been very light hearted and more of an introduction to most characters and places. With episode 5, I wanted to really throw the plot in there while still trying to maintain the pacing as much as I could. From the pov of my script, more could have happened in this episode which I will include in the next update. (These won't count towards episode 6 but will be added to this one. So the release of episode 6 will include some content for episode 5 too). 

Please remember that the length of one episode doesn't indicate the length of every future episode. Some might feel short, some might feel long. There's a lot that has to happen before episode 15. And If I feel like an episode was 'too short', I'll always add more to it in the next update. The story is above everything else for me so I won't try to finish it just for the sake of hitting that 15 episode.

I'll have to start packing up my PC as soon as possible since I leave in two weeks and need to make sure it's packed well. If some bugs do pop up, I'll use my laptop to fix them. Nothing game breaking should show up though since this is a pretty straight forward update in terms of coding. If you find typos or errors related to text, please post them on my discord under the bug reports channel. Here's hoping that this move helps me really settle down and gives me the opportunity to work on the game uninterrupted.

I hope you continue enjoying the game.

-CC

I was trying to be ambitious with two free-roam events this time but I'm probably going to have to stick to one event. I want there to be at least some variety since a lot of VN's use the same assets so I try to change colors / textures, add / remove props so there's a slightly more unique feel to the scenes. Most players won't even notice things like this but it's just something I think is important since there are 1000's of VNs out there.

tldr : If all goes well, I'll have the update out by the end of this month. If there are hiccups, Early May.

notes.title: Bug where you miss a scene with Talitha - fixed and uploaded
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
Thanks to a_svensson, a major bug has been found. I've fixed it and uploaded the fixed version.

The bug : If you're pursuing Talitha - After the scene with Amaris staring out the window, all you get is a black screen and text that she spent the night.

The fix : You get an actual scene of Talitha spending the night. The black screen with text appears AFTER you play through that scene.

I apologize for the inconvenience. For those of you who have already played through this episode, a quick renpy tip is to :
1. Head to options and select skip unseen text.
2. Go back to your game and hold down 'ctrl' . This will fast forward your game until there's a choice that     
    pops up
3. Fast forward until the Amaris scene and play the Talitha scene.

A few of you asked me why Talitha was skipped and I was under the impression that you wanted more than the current Talitha scene. Turns out you didn't get to see any Talitha scene. 
Again, sorry about this. The fixed version is already uploaded in case you want to watch the Talitha scene.

-CC

notes.title: print("Hello, Steam!)"
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! I'm really excited for my release on Steam and some of you have already wish listed the game so thank you for showing interest in the project. 
I've been playing VNs for a few years now and I've always had this story in my mind that I really wanted to turn into a game some day. This game has been in development for about half a year now and I've loved every part of working on it. I'm a solo developer so I do the writing, art and coding myself. I just feel like I have more control over everything this way and it's been working out great so far.

The Swordbearer - Season1 is going to be a long journey. Most of my time and energy goes to this project because I love working on it.
I'm not sure what you're looking for in [i]adult games[/i] but I can assure you, this VN will always prioritize story over adult content. Does this mean there'll be extensively long periods of time with no adult content? Of course not. This just means that the story has a higher priority. There's a good amount of adult content so far and I'm sure you'll agree when you go through the current version of the game.

As it stands, the Steam release will have the first two episodes but I'm doing my best to also include the third. Things are looking good so far, so I'm hopeful. 
Thank you again for checking this game out. I'm super grateful that you're interested and hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

-CC
